newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end weaker, Jan nears support.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end weaker, Jan nears support.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures added to recent losses, settling weaker and at session lows on continued speculative liquidation, market sources said.
Techniclly, the market is seen in a downtrend with support pegged at 95.00 cents a lb for January juice.
Tuesday's speculative/hedge report showed the speculators at 7.2 percent net long.

On the fundamental front, a freeze in Florida and increased demand, factors that could lift prices out of their slump, are not likely in the near term, said Celeste Georgakis, vice president with Dean Witter.
Meanwhile, expectations for more supplies in the market continued to pressure prices.
Most-active January closed down 0.55 at 96.60 after trading from 98.00 to 96.55. The back months finished 0.60 to 0.10 lower.
January set a life-of-contract low of 99.40.
Trade was thin at an estimated at 2,700 lots versus Tuesday's official tally of 4,230 lots.
